traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are fully implemented.
Both rules `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` share the same function-detection scope (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) with configurable `scope` and `exportPriority`, and they coordinate via shared helpers so changes in detection and scoping remain consistent. Arrow functions are not enforced by default, matching the story.
JSDoc parsing and annotation detection are implemented via dedicated helpers for both @story and @req, with robust error handling and fallback strategies. Error messages are clear, actionable, and anchored on the function name or closest identifier node, with tests confirming data payloads and suggestions.
Extensive Jest test coverage is present and passing, with multiple test suites explicitly tied to this story and its requirement IDs. Rule documentation files for both rules exist, reference this story, and document examples and configuration options. Based on this concrete evidence, the story is fully satisfied.
